scope: Deep static metadata inventory of code-like artifacts discoverable through the connected GitHub repository search. No code was executed, no external systems were probed, and no private material was accessed.
methodology: code-search enumeration using Python/import/name patterns and Ruby-related patterns
direct retrieval of representative source files
static inspection of imports, classes, functions, constants, filesystem/process operations, serialization, and hashes
provenance recording by repository path and blob SHA
important_coverage_note: The connector did not expose a single complete recursive directory listing in this workflow. Therefore this inventory records every code-like path returned by the searches performed plus directly inspected files; it does not claim mathematical completeness over every byte in the repository.

directly_inspected_files.purpose: Computes local file path/name/suffix/size/mtime and SHA-256.
Passive recursive text scan for configured name variants plus per-file size/mtime/SHA-256 metadata.
Reads JSON findings and renders a neutral verification report.
Fictional/game-mechanics framework representing metaphysical capabilities and restrictions.
Reset/snapshot utilities spanning fictional state, Git working state, Git author configuration, and filesystem timestamps. Contains subprocess calls to Git and filesystem mutation operations.

hash_observations.metadata.py: SHA-256 is used for local file integrity metadata; this is a digest, not encryption.
hash_observations.name_verifier.py: SHA-256 is used for scanned-file provenance records.
hash_observations.metadata_reset.py: No cryptographic hashing was observed in the inspected excerpt; its principal behavior is state/filesystem/Git mutation.

metadata_reset.py.reason: Some functions can discard uncommitted work, alter Git author configuration, remove files from the Git index, and rewrite timestamps.
recommended_controls: require explicit confirmation before destructive operations
show exact command and target path
avoid broad recursive targets by default

name_verifier.py.reason: Read-only scanning and hashing; no network or process execution observed.

report.py.reason: Reads JSON and prints formatted findings.

metaphysical_restrictions.py.reason: Simulation/game-style state model; its claims about metaphysical phenomena are not empirical evidence.

classification_rule: A path returned by code search is not automatically executable source code. Extensionless or unusual paths require content retrieval before language, purpose, or execution behavior can be established.
provenance: Repository search results and directly retrieved blobs from GitHub; all claims are limited to source material actually inspected.
status: Deep code metadata inventory uploaded; completeness is explicitly bounded by connector search coverage.
